cases.title: Verify Admin can save a Malaysian business registration number with parentheses in CST No on Edit Outlet
cases.preconditions: Setting default configuration=default (no company setting gates the CST No validation; after PR #10788 the rule allows letters, digits, '/', '-', '(', ')', '[', ']' and spaces for every company). User workflow "Edit Outlet" enabled. Admin user of the company under test (Staging Batleap) can log in on https://stagingbatleap.bizomstaging.in. Active retailer outlet {outletId} (not a distributor outlet) exists and is visible to the Admin. CST No (cst_no) field is shown, editable and not mandatory under Tax Details (default outlet form field configuration).
cases.steps:
1. Login to web as Admin and go to https://stagingbatleap.bizomstaging.in/outlets/edit/{outletId} and click on the Tax Details section
2. Login to web as Admin and go to https://stagingbatleap.bizomstaging.in/outlets/edit/{outletId} and enter '201701041932 (1256105-X)' in the CST No field
3. Login to web as Admin and go to https://stagingbatleap.bizomstaging.in/outlets/edit/{outletId} and click on Submit
4. Login to web as Admin and go to https://stagingbatleap.bizomstaging.in/outlets/edit/{outletId} and check the CST No field under Tax Details
cases.expected:
1. User should be able to login to web and see the Tax Details section expanded with the CST No field
2. User should be able to login to web and enter '201701041932 (1256105-X)' in CST No without any validation error
3. User should be able to login to web and save the outlet; System should redirect to /outlets/view/{outletId} with the message 'Outlet is saved successfully' and no 'Invalid CST no.' error
4. User should be able to login to web and see CST No pre-filled with '201701041932 (1256105-X)'
cases.test_data: [PR1-T13616] Outlet: {outletId} (active outlet of Staging Batleap); CST No: '201701041932 (1256105-X)'; field label = company alias for cst_no (default 'Cst no')
cases.actual: Edit RETAILERS 1747 > Tax Details > Outlet Cst no: '201701041932 (1256105-X)': browser valid=True, after Submit /outlets/view/1747 ['Outlet is saved successfully'], Edit shows '201701041932 (1256105-X)'
